company.name: Flowdash
company.shortDescription: The most customizable work management platform for fast-growing companies.
company.description:
Flowdash helps users in developing internal tools to track and execute human-in-the-loop workflows. It helps organizations to streamline their processes. Flowdash services cover claims processing, risk review, content moderation, vendor collaboration, and customer onboarding. 

The company is driven by a mission to bring happiness back to the workplace by changing the way people create software. Flowdash makes it easier to build applications without code so that individuals within every organization are empowered to create the tools they need.
